apps.name: CRM
apps.summary: Contacts, companies and deals, with the agent doing the follow-up. Like HubSpot.
apps.description: A pipeline of deals, the people and companies behind them, and a timeline of every email and meeting. The agent enriches companies, proposes the next step for each deal and drafts the email; nothing is sent until you approve it.

brief.user: Founders and the sales team of a small company
questions: Who do I have to talk to today, and why?

What happened with this person or company?

integrations.why: Reads mail with your contacts and sends the emails you approve.
Adds your meetings with contacts to their timeline.
Imports your existing companies, contacts and deals once.

outward: Sends emails from your Gmail, only the drafts you approve.
Reads your Gmail and Google Calendar when you turn sync on (read only).

integrations.why: Answers requests that came from the contact page.

apps.name: Outreach
apps.summary: Newsletters and email campaigns to your lists, with the agent finding missing emails. Like Mailchimp.
apps.description: Keep contacts and lists, write a newsletter or an announcement, see exactly who gets it and send it through your Resend account, now or at a set time. Every campaign has a report where each number opens the people behind it. Sequences write to people one at a time, reviewed first if you want, and the agent looks up the public email of contacts who have none. Unsubscribes, bounces and spam complaints are handled for you.

brief.user: Whoever sends the company's newsletters, announcements and outreach
questions: Who gets this email, and who is left out and why?
What went out, and who opened, replied, unsubscribed or bounced?
What is going out next?
brief.primaryAction: Write an email, pick its lists, send yourself a test, then send or schedule it

agent.why: Looks up the public email of contacts who have none, with the page it read it on.

integrations.why: Sends every email from your own domain, and tells Outreach about bounces, opens and clicks.

outward: Sends the emails you send, schedule or start, from your Resend account; nothing leaves on its own.
Publishes an unsubscribe page that anyone with a link from one of your emails can use.

apps.name: Invoices
apps.summary: Quotes and invoices your clients accept and pay online. Like Holded.
apps.description: Write a quote (or let the agent draft it from one sentence), issue it with the next number, and send the client a link where they accept it or pay the invoice by bank transfer or card. The agent drafts payment reminders for overdue invoices; nothing is sent until you approve it. Not certified fiscal software: it does not submit anything to a tax authority (no Verifactu, SII or e-invoicing).

brief.user: The owner, or whoever keeps the books, of a small company or a freelancer
questions: How much am I owed, and who is late?

brief.primaryAction: Issue an invoice or a quote, and send it to the client

agent.why: Drafts quotes from a sentence and writes payment reminders for you to approve.

integrations.why: Sends quotes, invoices and reminders from your address, only when you press Send or Approve.

outward: Sends emails from your Gmail, only the ones you send or approve.
Creates a Stripe payment link for each invoice, when you turn Stripe on.
Publishes a page per document that only someone with its link can open.

apps.name: Tables
apps.summary: Restaurant bookings without per-cover fees: your own booking page and a service sheet for the door. Like CoverManager or TheFork Manager.
apps.description: Guests book a table on your own page (from Instagram, Google Maps or your website): they pick a day, how many they are and a time, and inside your rules the table is theirs at once, with the smallest free table that fits. Each guest gets a link to confirm, change or cancel. At the door, Today is the service sheet: who comes, at what time, how many, at which table, with notes and allergies, and Arrived or No-show on each row; a walk-in or a phone booking is one button. Guests build up by themselves (visits, no-shows, VIPs), or import them from TheFork, CoverManager or Quandoo. Sources shows where bookings come from and estimates the commission you avoided. Optional: confirmations and reminders through your Gmail or your Resend, and an agent that reads booking emails in Gmail and books them for you.

brief.user: A restaurant: the host at the door, the manager, the owner
brief.frequency: Every service, and whenever the phone rings
questions: Who comes today, at what time, how many, at which table?
Which bookings wait for my OK?
Who are my guests, and where do bookings come from?
brief.primaryAction: Seat a guest: mark Arrived, or add a walk-in or a phone booking

agent.why: Optional: reads booking emails in your Gmail and writes a brief before each service. Off until you turn it on.

integrations.why: Optional, one of Gmail or Resend, to email guests: their confirmation, reminders and change notices, from your own address (replies land there). Also the inbox the optional agent reads. Bookings work without it.
Optional, one of Gmail or Resend, to email guests: the same emails, from an address on your own domain verified in Resend. Bookings work without it.

outward: Publishes a booking page that anyone with the link can use; inside your rules a booking is confirmed at once.
When you turn emails on: sends each guest their confirmation, a reminder about a day before and a note when the booking changes, through the sender you choose (your Gmail or your Resend).
When you turn booking emails on: answers booking emails inside your rules from your Gmail; every other reply waits for your OK.

apps.name: Appointments
apps.summary: Appointments for salons and clinics with no commission on new clients: a booking page, the day's agenda per person, and where every client came from. Like Fresha or Booksy.
apps.description: Clients book online from your page (from Instagram, Google Maps or your website: a link for each), picking the service, the person or whoever is free, a day and a time, and get a private link to change or cancel before your deadline. The desk shows today's agenda with a column per person: book a phone call in two clicks, mark arrived or no-show, block time; the week, clients with their history and notes, services with buffers, your team's hours with breaks and days off. Sources shows where appointments come from and what booking direct saved against a marketplace's new-client fee. Confirmations and reminders go through your Gmail or your Resend, whichever you choose; optionally, the agent books from booking emails in Gmail too.

brief.user: The owner and the front desk of a hair or beauty salon, barber, aesthetics or physio clinic
brief.frequency: All day: the agenda is open while the business is

integrations.why: Optional, one of Gmail or Resend, to email clients: their confirmation, reminders and change notices, from your own address (replies land there). Also the inbox the optional agent reads. Bookings work without it.
Optional, one of Gmail or Resend, to email clients: the same emails, from an address on your own domain verified in Resend. Bookings work without it.

outward: Publishes a booking page that anyone with the link can use, and a private page for each client to change or cancel their appointment.
Sends each client their confirmation, any change or cancellation and reminders through the sender you choose (your Gmail or your Resend), only if you turn emails on.
